title: pcapng: just use WS_ROUNDUP_n() and WS_PADDING_TO_n() directly.
description:
ROUND_TO_4BYTE() is defined to be WS_ROUNDUP_4(); just use
WS_ROUNDUP_4() directly.

PADDING4() produces the same result as WS_PADDING_TO_4(); just use
WS_ROUNDUP_4().

Unsignedify some byte counts while we're at it.
